notes: Written from the guide's 'Game plan by turn' and 'Playbook seeds'. Numbers are heuristic units (about one card); they are tuning, not strategy claims.
goFirst: strategy-concepts §10 [S17] 'go second with removal, late-game and counter-heavy decks'; the guide calls Kaido 'a removal-and-defense build' [SH-KAI].
weights.don: the guide's DON!! engine (King, Queen, Hawkins, Yamato add DON!!; the top end pays DON!! −X).
cardValue: ongoing effects named in the guide's Defining cards (King's ramp and K.O. shield, Kaido OP17-062's refund, Kaido OP17-063's hand Counters, Queen OP17-065's Banish).

assertions.text: Uses the leader's DON!! −1 on the opponent's Character attacker when it is legal and changes the battle result before blocks and counters, in at least 80% of such attacks.
In at least 80% of the leader's −2000 activations on the opponent's turn, the Counter needed to stop that attack falls by at least 1000.
Plays a DON!!-adding Character (Queen EB04-032, Hawkins, Yamato or King) by T3 in at least 80% of games.
When playing Ulti & Page One, attacks with the leader and applies the −2000 first that turn, when a 5000-power target exists.
Lands a 9- or 10-cost Character by T5 in at least 60% of games.

leaderTrick.claim: It shrank your attacker instead of spending a counter.
leaderTrick.nextTime: Against Kaido, attack first with the Character you least need to land: it draws out the once-per-turn −2000. It can never shrink your Leader.
